sections.heading: Common ADA Door Problems We Repair
sections.body: ADA door systems experience wear and tear just like any other mechanical system, and certain issues tend to appear repeatedly in busy commercial environments. Some of the most common problems we repair include automatic operators that move too slowly or too quickly, door closers that fail to hold doors open for the required duration, misaligned door frames that cause dragging or difficult operation, malfunctioning push-button activation panels, and broken or damaged door hardware including hinges, pivots, and pulls. Glass components in ADA-accessible entrances may also crack or break, compromising both safety and function. Our technicians carry a wide inventory of replacement parts and are experienced working with major brands of automatic door operators and commercial door hardware. We diagnose the root cause of each problem rather than applying temporary fixes, ensuring your accessible entrances remain reliable over the long term.
